messages:
ryan-support: Heads up — customer acct_12345 (Acme Analytics) opened a ticket: free trial credits went from ~5,000 to 0 overnight. They say embeddings/rerank endpoints spiked. Can we pause billing and investigate?

sarah-billing: @ryan-support paused new chargeable activity for acct_12345 and flagged for review. I can put a temporary credit hold while we investigate — need logs + sample timestamps.

ryan-support: Thanks. Customer sent approximate window: 2026-02-10 03:10–03:20 UTC. They pasted a snippet from their worker showing repeated calls. Dropping the snippet here.

mei-eng: paste the sample logs — quick check: are they using retries without idempotency?

ryan-support: Here is what they provided:

```
2026-02-10T03:11:56Z INFO batch_runner job=embed-batch-842 items=120
2026-02-10T03:11:57Z INFO call embeddings endpoint model=text-embed-001 count=120 request_id=req-01
2026-02-10T03:11:57Z ERROR http 502 req-01
2026-02-10T03:11:57Z INFO retry attempt=1 delay=0.5s req-01
2026-02-10T03:11:58Z INFO call embeddings endpoint model=text-embed-001 count=120 request_id=req-01
2026-02-10T03:11:58Z INFO http 200 req-01 tokens=120 cost=0.12
2026-02-10T03:12:57Z INFO batch_runner job=embed-batch-843 items=120
2026-02-10T03:12:57Z INFO call embeddings endpoint model=text-embed-001 count=120 request_id=req-02
... (repeats every minute)
```

ryan-support: They say the job runs every minute and will re-process items until success, no dedupe / idempotency keys. Looks like a combination of frequent batching + replays.

mei-eng: Confirmed on our side — I pulled the usage map for acct_12345 and see a sharp step-up at 03:10 UTC with ~3,600 embedding calls in 15 minutes. Pattern matches a scheduled worker that retried on 5xx without dedupe. We also saw a few 502s from our edge during that window due to a transient upstream issue.

matt-ops: ops-bot shows a transient worker pool restart in region-us-west-2 at 03:11:57 which likely contributed to the 502s. Noted.

ops-bot: [automated] incident #INC-2026-42: transient proxy error 502 (us-west-2) 03:11:55–03:12:05 UTC — resolved.

mei-eng: Root cause summary for now: customer had a background job that batches embeddings every minute; when transient 502s occurred they retried the whole batch without idempotency, resulting in duplicate requests and extra cost. Rerank usage also showed similar duplicates.

ryan-support: Action items: 1) Offer immediate trial credit top-up / refund, 2) Share mitigation steps (idempotency keys, exponential backoff + jitter, dedupe by item id, increase batch window), 3) Recommend rate-limit / quota for background jobs. Any objections?

sarah-billing: I'll approve a one-time credit grant of 4,800 credits (covers most of the spike) and mark the account as trial/credit-override. I'll also schedule a follow-up review for a potential full refund escalation if customer shows more evidence. Will confirm after I apply it.

mei-eng: Technical notes to include in reply: sample idempotent pattern — use a request-level idempotency key or de-dup by job+item id; if using retries, replay smaller batches (per-item or per-10) and use exponential backoff capped at ~5 attempts. Example snippet to send: 

```
# pseudo
for item in items:
  key = f\"embed:{item.id}\"
  if not seen(key):
    resp = client.embeddings.create(input=item.text, idempotency_key=key)
    mark_seen(key)
```

ryan-support: I'll draft the support reply with the credit offer + technical guidance and ask them to confirm they've implemented idempotency before we lift the credit hold. Also recommending they switch to batched embedding sizes that match their cost constraints and use our batching hints doc link: https://docs.redwood.ai/embedding-batching

sarah-billing: Credit applied: +4800 trial credits to acct_12345. Notified customer. I'll hold an additional 200 credits in reserve until they confirm config changes.

ryan-support: Customer replied: ":wave thanks — we missed the idempotency key in our worker. We'll roll a fix in staging and confirm. Appreciate the fast help"

mei-eng: Afterfix check we should run: 1) confirm subsequent runs don't produce duplicate request patterns, 2) check for stable 200 rates for same job ids, 3) recommend a smoke test that simulates a 502 from the API and ensures the client does not replay full batch.

matt-ops: I'll add a temporary quota on background-batch endpoints for trial accounts to catch this class of issues automatically (throttle to X requests/min per account) — will propose a conservative default.

ryan-support: Marking thread resolved from support side once customer confirms staging fix. TL;DR: credits unexpectedly consumed due to minute-scheduled background job + retries on 502 without idempotency; billing granted 4800 credits; engineering provided mitigation steps.

sarah-billing: Closing ticket on billing side after 48h if no additional claims.

ryan-support: Thanks everyone. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
